notes.title: Big Update ( New Map + Performance Update )
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38000864/e781fe059f81e73664a4fab8549611bb5cd01e32.png[/img]

Our Chinese server is open.

[b]The hangar map has been added to the game. [/b](Includes TDM - FFA modes only)

[b]You can have all weapons for free.[/b] (All players will have access to all weapons in the game)

XP rates have been changed in the rank system and rank is still needed to unlock weapons.

Quick Play settings changed from FFA to TDM.

The bug that occurred in the registration process in the Inventory section has been fixed.

Problems with AI on maps have been resolved. (This problem still persists in the 64-person option.)

Fixed collider issues that caused tanks to get stuck in some areas on the El-Kebar map.

The resolution of all textures in the game has been reduced from 2048 to 1024[b] (It will provide a performance increase for players with low graphics cards)[/b]

Minor changes have been made to the post processing settings.

The problem of not firing after the magazine change on the TAR-21 gun has been resolved.

notes.title: How to Find Server and Change Language.
MAJOR UPDATE - China Connection Problem (Fixed)
notes.notes:
We quickly resolved the connection problems of our Chinese players.

Our Chinese users who have problems during registration can connect to the game using the "guest" section.

24 different major and minor bugs have been fixed.

The drop rate of some in-game items has been reduced.

You may need to verify the game files or delete and reinstall the game to play the new version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38000864/7d1df3583c3fadebdaced9022d20c991df8af3b5.png[/img]

notes.title: We're BACK!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38000864/a1936ec518b0d1c9a75af1592b1308e0b1fece8f.png[/img]

We are together again after 3 weeks of left!
During this period, we developed the game further and reopened our store.
I hope you missed us as much as we missed you.
We will be posting [b]OUR BIG UPDATE[/b] soon.
Most things will be better than they your first experience!
We would be very happy if you share your feedback with us.
Thanks.

notes.title: READ BEFORE YOU REGISTER TO THE GAME! - VERY IMPORTANT!
notes.notes:
[b]MAILS ARE AUTOMATICALLY APPROVED.
YOU DO NOT NEED TO CHECK YOUR MAIL.
DO NOT CARE IF YOU SEE THE "CHECK YOUR MAIL" WARNING.[/b]

When registering for the game, [b]DO NOT FORGET[/b] to take a [b]SCREENSHOT [/b]before sending your registration information for approval.

Set something to remember for  your [b]LOGIN NAME.[/b]
Because you will get into the game with it.

Pay attention to the following when logging into the game!

[b]LOGIN NAME  is your USER NAME[/b] not your Nick!
Do not write your nick here!
Otherwise, you cannot enter the game!

In case of any mishaps, you can add us or contact us on our discord server.

[b]Discord[/b]: https://discord.gg/e5cMpC5

[b]Mail[/b]: oxo.games.2019@gmail.com

notes.title: Poly Squad Update Note v.1002
notes.notes:
[h2]New Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] For those who have problems in the login section, the "Remember Me" button has been added and edited. Now if you activate the "Remember Me" option before logging in. The next time you enter the game, your information will be written automatically and you will be able to enter quickly.
[*] 
[/list]
[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Character shift speed increased from 2 to 2.2 and fixed.
[*] 
[/list]
[h2]Corrections[/h2]
[list]
[*] The shooting problem occurred on the AK12 weapon has been fixed.
[*] Fixed the problem with the weapon named M200 not opening the scope.
[*] Fixed the problem of occasionally not being able to board vehicles named TANKUS and TANKRUS.
[/list]

[h2]El-Kebar[/h2]
[list]
[*] The spawnpoints of the Terrorist team on the El-Kebar map have been adjusted.
[/list]

notes.title: Poly Squad Update Note v.1001
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38000864/49fd4fc27f2351f748f3d1490137dba56292ab0d.png[/img]
[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Clan creation fee has been reduced from 1500 Gold to 500.
[*] Score Score per kill increased from 75 to 100.
[*] Score Score per Full Head hit increased from 100 to 150.
[*] The "Match Winning Score" when winning the game has been increased from 750 to 800.
[*] The gain of 1 Gold for every 300 points in the Gold earning system is now adjusted to 1 Gold per 100 points.
[*] AFK Limit increased from 60 seconds to 120.
[*] UNSF and Terrorist team character speeds reduced from 6 to 5.8.
[/list]

[h2]Corrections[/h2]
[list]
[*] The problem of not being able to log in to the game after registration has been fixed.
[*] The problem with texts intertwined in the chat window has been fixed.
[*] Fixed uniforms showing off in the customization screen despite having weapon and vehicle skins in the Steam Inventory.
[*] The BORA-12 weapon scope problem has been fixed.
[*] Fixed the issue of loud noise caused by the battle background sound on the maps.
[/list]

[h2]Arkov[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where bots in the UNSF team could not step out of the Arkov map.
[*] Fixed the issue where UNSF team players were stuck underground on the Arkov map.
[/list]

[h2]El-Kebar[/h2]
[list]
[*] The artificial intelligence in the El-Kebar map now works more properly.
[*] Fixed collider errors in El-Kebar map.
[*] The plane area in the UNSF team area on the El-Kebar map has been moved to the right of the main area.
[/list]

[h2]Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Performance loss for AMD Graphics card users has been fixed.
[/list]
